clips.title: The story
paras: In Silverpine Forest, Glutton Shackles lend strength to Arugal’s flawed sorcery. The mad archmage crafted these enchanted restraints for Moonrage Glutton worgen.

Feral worgen infest Silverpine Forest, and the Forsaken’s trained mages see them as proof of poor arcane work. Dalar Dawnweaver, an accomplished arcanist stationed at the Sepulcher, holds Archmage Arugal in contempt and calls him an incompetent hack unworthy of the Kirin Tor. Dawnweaver found that Arugal relied on enchanted relics to shore up his fragile spells. The heavy Moonrage Gluttons that roam northern Silverpine wear Glutton Shackles, magical anchors that reinforce the curse binding the beasts.
